Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I would like to know if a Malkavian using the effect of the Madness Network
during the turn of another Methuselah can play out-of-turn cards (like
Röshtreck or Obedience if he enters combat, or Direct Intervention to cancel
intercept, etc...) ? Or, if the action is not blocked, can another Vampire
of the acting Methuselah play reaction cards (like Surprise Influence in a
referendum). If yes, can the acting minion play action modifier (like
Bewitching Oration in a referendum) or play himself reaction cards ? And
last, can a tapped Malkavian can untap with a Second Tradition to make an
action ?

As you can see, the possibilities of this card are not clear for us, and
this can represent some great combos...

LSJ, if you can answer this, I will be very grateful,

Thank you very much for your time,

Rafid Armani

Messages.Author: Noal McDonald
Messages.Body:
"Rafid Armani" <ra...@mediom.qc.ca> wrote:
> I would like to know if a Malkavian using the effect of the Madness
> Network during the turn of another Methuselah can play out-of-turn

> [master] cards?... Or, if the action is not blocked, can another
> Vampire of the acting Methuselah play reaction cards?

These questions were already brought up this week.

The controller of the Malkavian making use of the Madness Network may
play Out of Turn Master Cards but may not play reaction cards.

> And last, can a tapped Malkavian can untap with a Second Tradition
> to make an action?

Only if the 2nd Tradition was prior to attempt to block an action and
fail. In the NJL and in the VEKN (AIUI), to use the 2nd Tradition you
_must_ be using it in conjuction with a legitimate attempt to block.

The only difference in the card, to my knowledge, is that in NJL the
vampire using it _must_ be tapped, whereas in VEKN the vampire _may_ be
tapped.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Rafid Armani wrote:
> I would like to know if a Malkavian using the effect of the Madness Network

> during the turn of another Methuselah can play out-of-turn cards (like
> Röshtreck or Obedience if he enters combat, or Direct Intervention to cancel
> intercept, etc...) ?

Malkavians (and minion vampires in general) cannot play Master cards at
all. Only Methuselahs can play master cards, and they can play out-of-turn
masters only "during another player's turn" [1.6.2.3]

Obedience is not an out-of-turn card, it is a reaction card.
Your minions cannot play reaction cards on an action taken by
one of your minions. [1.6.3.5]

> Or, if the action is not blocked, can another Vampire

> of the acting Methuselah play reaction cards (like Surprise Influence in a
> referendum).

No. [1.6.3.5]

> If yes, can the acting minion play action modifier (like
> Bewitching Oration in a referendum) or play himself reaction cards ? And

The acting minion can play action modifiers. [1.6.3.2]

> last, can a tapped Malkavian can untap with a Second Tradition to make an
> action ?

No. Although he could untap with 2nd tradition in an attempt to block
somone else's action and, if he fails to block (e.g., the acting minion
gets +3 stealth), he'll remain untapped and could therefore take an
action at the end of a player's minion phase.
